integrity: Prior existence/count of the equilateral two three-cycles is credited; the new claim is the complete global basin, dyadic capture-time law, and sharp nonconvergence of one-sided basin densities; the proof and exact-rational diagnostics are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Equilateral complete supporting lines only; one-sided ray frequencies, not symmetric-window densities; not a perturbation stability theorem.
title: Dyadic basin shells and nonconvergent spatial frequencies for the equilateral farthest-projection map
